name: Image Generation Agent
description: Generates 2D scientific illustrations with FLUX.2-pro from the biological context gathered by other agents. Covers rendered images, illustrations, diagrams and visual depictions of a species or protein based on its described traits. Routes to Trait Discovery when morphological, physiological, behavioral, functional, or structural traits are not yet available in context. It does not predict 3D protein structures.
capabilities: Orchestrator routing for missing trait interpretation

input.context: dict needing a species OR a protein/gene identifier, plus traits from Trait Discovery Agent

output.traits_used: list of trait strings used for the visualization
